rows: A training that showcases what AI does today in cyber by showing existing use in our organization, discuss about planned future development and beyond.

N1.1 · What AI does today in cyber
Describe what AI and agents already do well in one's own domain and the neighbouring ones: triage and enrichment, log and code analysis, drafting and summarising, policy mapping, test generation

N1.2 · What is emerging
Describe what is emerging in AI for cyber, beyond what is in production today

N1.3 · How one's own work changes
Name two or three ways one's own work could change. The purpose is to open the mind to a new way of working, not to teach a tool
